notes: Chat text and the position panel are fully legible; panel values verified at 3x zoom. The grey zone measured off the IMG_7807 chart was ~73,774-74,577, so 73,900 sits INSIDE that band - the two are consistent. The LINK/USD position is the same one tracked across IMG_7805 (entry $8.7933 throughout, SIZE $1,000,814.99 throughout); here leverage has risen again to 7.42x with collateral down to $134,797.44 and mark $9.7929 (+$111,404.77 / +82.39%). Header again reads 'Positions 3' so two other positions exist off-panel. Venue is not named. The line 'Ace Okay yes I'm {long} with Hefty amount already at avg rn sitting at 64.3k per btc, look close...' is a QUOTED/replied-to earlier Ace message shown as a reply preview (truncated with an ellipsis by the app), not a new message posted at this point in the scroll - it is recorded in the transcript and in boasts but deliberately NOT given a timestamp in 'statements'. One further message line is partially visible below the 👍 4 reaction, but only the top 1-2 pixel rows of its glyphs clear the 'Done reading?' banner - it is NOT transcribed because it cannot be read. The 19:37 and 19:44 blocks each contain an untimestamped continuation line from the same minute-group ('Just a small scalp'), attributed to the group's timestamp. The reaction on the position-panel message renders as a purple star-of-David-style emoji with count 2. Spelling and grammar left verbatim throughout ('since it enter the zone').
